facts.text: I'm one of the heaviest land animals in North America!
I live on prairies, plains and in river valleys.
I can weigh as much as a small car!
My calf is a lighter color for its first two months.
I love to roll in the dirt. It's called wallowing!
I'm the national mammal of the United States!
Long ago, about 60 million of us roamed North America.
Once only 541 of us were left, but people saved us!

racers.caption: I'm about four times faster than you!
I'm about three times faster than a bike!
I can outrun a car driving through town!

foods.caption: Mmm, grass! I graze all day long.
No thanks! Bison only eat plants.
No, thank you! I'd rather munch grass.
